result.rationale: The migration directly interpolates the raw site-setting value: `INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, category_id, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)` — any host entry containing a single quote breaks the SQL, and it's also a SQL injection vector via the stored setting. This is verifiable in the diff and a real defect in newly introduced code.

judged_text: The INSERT interpolates the raw site-setting value h into SQL via string interpolation ("VALUES ('#{h}', ..."), so a host entry containing a single quote aborts the migration with a PG syntax error. Any site whose old embeddable_hosts setting contains a malformed/quoted entry fails db:migrate mid-migration, leaving the table half-populated and the transaction-dependent DELETE of the old settings never executed.
